title: WatchBox Service Record Service Cost Leaderboard
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watchbox:service service_cost_usd=*
| stats sum(service_cost_usd) as total_value, avg(service_cost_usd) as avg_value by service_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks service type values by total and average service cost across WatchBox service record events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `service_cost_usd` values for each WatchBox service record event and review total and average service cost by service type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total service cost.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which service type shows the biggest service cost numbers in your WatchBox service record data.
